description: Who is signed in, and what is today in Japan? Returns staff ID, name, organization (所属), and role (company_admin 企業管理者 / admin 一般管理者 / employee 従業員), plus today (YYYY-MM-DD) and timezone Asia/Tokyo. Call this to learn the role before assuming admin tools exist. For what to do before leaving or at month-end, use close_out instead.
name: get_my_profile
title: Get my profile
